Government flags corruption risks in 10 federal institutions! 🇵🇰
According to Arab News, Law Minister Azam Nazeer Tarar said on Friday that a government assessment has flagged 10 federal institutions for heightened corruption risks. Those he named include the Federal Board of Revenue, the Benazir Income Support Program, Pakistan Railways, the National Highway Authority, Sui Northern Gas Pipelines and state-owned electricity distribution companies. The review, coordinated by the Ministry of Law and Justice, covered 25 federal institutions against more than 300 indicators and proposed about 400 reforms. Tarar said it is "not a charge sheet against anyone" and called it a precautionary mechanism. The assessment will be made public after approval by the prime minister and federal cabinet.
